Fresh worktrees that send protocol observations outside the checkout can fail before reader-cache reservation because the fixed lock parent is missing. Document the parent-only preparation command, who runs it and when, plus the external-observation invocation. Existing locks remain blockers.

The unchanged reservation was demonstrated on isolated synthetic paths: a missing parent failed before cache movement; preparing it allowed normal restoration of cache contents, inode and mode; an existing lock was rejected and preserved. Automatic fixture changes remain outside this documentation remedy.

Refs #100.

<details>
<summary>Technical appendix: scope and validation</summary>

Four documentation paths change against main: `docs/operations/environment.md`, `docs/operations/verification.md`, the existing `LESSONS-READER-PARENT-01` task, and one append-only F002 handling record. The preparation command creates only `artifacts/baseline-compatibility-20261013/A09`. `SIMRECON_PROTOCOLS_EVIDENCE` moves A09 run observations; the shared lock, reader cache and canonical receipt/log/coverage locations stay fixed. No runtime, test, fixture, dependency, workflow, coverage or lock-lifecycle changes.

Main PR #101 arrived during the first gate and supplied the original doctor intake/probe. This branch integrates it, reconciles the task's add/add conflict, preserves original stable IDs and charges, and supersedes only F002 handling in the earlier tracked disposition. F003 and observation confidence remain unchanged; the new record stays tracked pending final checks/review and human PR integration. Initial 404s are historical availability limits, now superseded by the opened original records. The operational docs and synthetic inputs were unchanged by integration; independent review retained applicability of the diagnostic evidence.

The synthetic demonstration used Python 3.13.12 and unchanged fixture SHA-256 `eaf31b30080cb1997d27012ecc9ad0689515dc14d17c61f8f3b4c7216a10551f`. It retained errno 2/17 outcomes, exact script/commands, before/after inventories and restoration records outside the checkout. Repeated parent-only `mkdir -p` calls exited 0 without changing the empty parent. The task records observed outcomes and evidence locations. This proves local normal-unwinding behavior, with no claim about crash recovery, concurrency, permissions or cross-platform reader qualification. The earlier doctor probe and this new run are distinct evidence.

Exact submitted candidate `3fdef0b8ed4383c7b6e6d04e6111921f843758d9`, tree `4cb93f40e216ea68f72b8105d08396909c0f6434`, integrated with main `d48e0e47b315e79a8c8ab33bc81b3f7f235e3c3c`. All 1,215 tracked-file hashes and both explicit diagnostic-input fingerprints remained unchanged; the run started and ended clean. Tests/fixtures are unchanged baseline bytes; no new test-review checkpoint is claimed.

Canonical local `make verify` passed all 13 phases on Linux with CPython 3.13.12, uv 0.12.19 and selected JDK 21.0.7. The existing activation was sourced, this worktree’s `.venv/bin` led `PATH`, the fixed parent was prepared, and `SIMRECON_PROTOCOLS_EVIDENCE=/workspace/shared/reader-parent-100/integrated-full-protocol-observations` was exported. `VERIFY_ARGS` named contract `LESSONS-READER-PARENT-01`, the base above, and immutable `parent-diagnostic`/`parent-diagnostic-script` inputs. The exact invocation is retained as `integrated-full-verify-command.sh`.

Final results: **3,100 passed, 47 warnings**, 462.32 s for pytest; 511.935112 s for the full gate. Product/development wheels built and passed separate installed-environment checks. Locked audit found no known vulnerabilities or adverse project statuses in 29 packages.

Current native reports cover all 36 owned Python files, including never-imported files and relevant subprocesses:

| Scope | Covered/total native statements | Covered/total branches |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Global | 4834/4972 | 1854/1964 |
| simrecon | 3993/4128 | 1534/1640 |
| simrecon_devtools | 39/39 | 8/8 |
| scripts | 802/805 | 312/316 |

Same-run M25 ID `fd383c27-e6ef-44ea-82a5-ca839468787a`: native high-water baseline/peak both 100,732 KiB, measured increment 0 bytes against unchanged 33,554,432-byte limit. This is the reported high-water delta, not a zero-allocation claim.

Static-version `0.1.0` artifacts: product wheel SHA-256 `0d32c34e07b8483d1ed473a57abd4746ebb6ef887d5ca008705e39d7371a6dc0`; development wheel SHA-256 `177054cef0020008805abe3de9d8bbcd97b78eb26a449ca66a04b2aa4c3c21bd`.

Durable local evidence under `/workspace/shared/reader-parent-100/` includes diagnostic script/results/journals, author report, integrated documentation checks, full command/log, `integrated-full-verification-receipt.json` (SHA-256 `a5a14397dd0dc2be62aa0acd9ee5f003f46cf3d33328b7eda4ac70a944bfe5cf`) and `integrated-full-gate-evidence.tar.gz` (SHA-256 `3caf0869811ebd4a482b862407907d3f261fe80f475a38eefb972b791812fde8`), with complete coverage JSON/HTML, receipt/logs, measurements and wheels. The tracked task points to final `completion.json`. These retained artifacts are local evidence, not a hosted download; CI separately retains its own outputs.

The first exact candidate also passed 13 phases and 3,100 tests before main advanced; its receipt/archive remain preserved under non-integrated names and `pre-integration-completion.json`. It is historical evidence, not substituted for this second run.

The approved coverage policy remains behavior coverage with independent risk review and advisory native statement/branch percentages. Required native report integrity, owned-file/package/subprocess scope, two-worker grouping, all 13 full phases and same-run M25 evidence remain binding. No separate language-level statement or unsupported line metric is claimed. Ubuntu 24.04/macOS 15 CI will produce separate platform evidence after PR creation; pending CI is not a pass.

Fresh independent remedy policy review **ACCEPTED** exact candidate `3fdef0b8ed4383c7b6e6d04e6111921f843758d9`, including the integrated receipt, diagnostic preservation, documentation/disposition scope and PR presentation; no findings. Durable report `policy-review-final.md`, SHA-256 `e72ba9577d1cafbb39799c4bad46d7f89fa6cbe445fd9718e2cdddc2636cca58`. CI remains pending at submission.

Cumulative correction scope: seven scenarios, four diagnostic conditions, one documentation author/run, one synthetic run, zero author corrections, one coordinator integration correction and two full-gate attempts (the first passing pre-integration run is retained separately). Intake and remedy policy reviews remain separately accounted. The parent doctor task's nine delegated launches are linked without adding them to this correction's four delegate launches. Human-set numeric limits are not set; actual served attribution, tokens/cost and unavailable complete historical metering remain unknown. Disposable synthetic scratch was removed after review; durable evidence, checkout and shared environments were retained. No merge/release or issue closure is requested.

</details>

Exceptions raised while Python cleans up an object could print source code through the source-free launcher, even when the process exited successfully. This change omits those source snippets while preserving the exception type, message, file and line, and native exit status. It also covers inherited Python children and pytest's warning-as-error reports.

Closes #99.

<details>
<summary>Technical appendix: implementation and validation</summary>

The correction installs `sys.unraisablehook` using the existing diagnostic renderer and narrowly adjusts singular `PytestUnraisableExceptionWarning` test reports. Twenty public-launcher regression cases cover finalization/shutdown, child inheritance, statuses 0/7, warning filters/promotion, and both pytest invocation modes. All 65 existing diagnostic cases are retained; grouped-finalizer rendering already worked and remains unchanged. Authored messages are preserved; this is not a universal content-redaction guarantee.

[Contract and execution pointer](https://github.com/david-hoffman/simrecon/blob/2c65125e0c4ef4c3243ef1632cc913eba2323f3e/docs/tasks/lessons-unraisable-diagnostics.md) · [Scoped evidence and mapping](https://github.com/david-hoffman/simrecon/blob/2c65125e0c4ef4c3243ef1632cc913eba2323f3e/docs/reports/lessons-unraisable-diagnostics.md)

- Candidate: `2c65125e0c4ef4c3243ef1632cc913eba2323f3e`; tree: `1f5ae63d97c40acacba3c804b3fb6e380bfc0b18`.
- Integration base: `02bb2c95aada93057186d6efcde0050ffb7d597e`. Main's documentation-only updates and original doctor intake are reconciled; runtime/test hashes match the earlier accepted correction `8e71a6b`.
- Canonical command: `make verify VERIFY_ARGS='--contract LESSONS-UNRAISABLE-01 --base 02bb2c95aada93057186d6efcde0050ffb7d597e'` in the pinned environment.
- Full local result: **passed all 13 phases**; 3120 passed, 47 warnings in 660.05s (0:11:00); both installed-wheel checks and locked audit (29 packages) passed.
- Fresh independent bounded agent review: accepted this exact candidate with no actionable findings.
- Environment: Linux x86-64, CPython 3.13.12, uv 0.12.19, locked pytest 9.1.1, Temurin 21.0.7+6. Ubuntu 24.04/macOS 15 CI: pending for this PR.

Receipts, logs and independent review are retained in ignored task-specific evidence directories; the linked report preserves baseline results and reproducible test mapping. CI evidence will be associated with this PR.

Cumulative correction gates: three attempts (one coordinator-interrupted technical-timeout correction, one accepted pre-integration run, and this merged-candidate run).
